evals.expected_output: Agent directory with host state, no tunnel tokens
expectations: Calls list_agents and removes host_tunnel_token before showing anything
Displays each agent's name, kind, owner_only, a2a_enabled, host_name/host_os and host_online, credentials and pair_count
Does not confuse agents with devices or bots
Checks the API response status field

evals.prompt: Create a new agent called Fable
evals.expected_output: Checks entitlements, creates the agent, explains hosting
expectations: Checks the entitlements for the agents feature and free agent seats (limits.agents) before creating
Calls create_agent with agent_name=Fable (kind defaults to agent, a2a off)
Explains that the agent starts owner-only and has no host yet; points to the doxxGateway (github.com/doxxcorp/gateway) or the Mac app's Agent Gateway
Does not claim agents need a P2P plan or Pro; Essentials includes agents
Calls list_agents to resolve Fable's agent_id
Warns that deletion revokes all its pairs and its device credential (the chat identity is gone)
Asks for confirmation before calling delete_agent
Notes the device and tunnel remain and can be removed separately with delete_tunnel

evals.prompt: Create a bot for my server
evals.expected_output: Explains bots are deprecated and offers an agent
expectations: Explains that bots are deprecated (create_bot returns 410) and replaced by agents
Offers to create an agent with create_agent instead
Does not call create_bot

evals.prompt: Move my agent Fable to my Mac mini and let my friends talk to it
evals.expected_output: Re-hosts the agent and unlocks owner-only after confirmation
expectations: Calls list_agents for Fable's agent_id and device_list_unified for the Mac mini's device_hash
Explains before acting that re-hosting revokes the current host's credentials at once and the agent is silent until the Mac mini claims it
Explains that owner_only=0 lets introduced friends reach the agent, each still needing to accept (double opt-in)
Gets confirmation, then calls update_agent with agent_id, host_device_hash and owner_only=0, and reports the changed fields

evals.prompt: Change Fable's status message to 'on vacation'
evals.expected_output: Explains the status line is not set through the API
expectations: Does not send motd to update_agent (the API refuses it with 410)
Explains that the status line travels over the mesh from the owner's device to the agent's host and is set in the app
On an agent_limit error, shows message and upgrade_url verbatim and that used equals max
Offers to remove an existing agent instead; does not buy agent seats or retry in a loop

evals.prompt: How do I make my agent send me a chat message from a script?
evals.expected_output: Separates the chat layer from network management
expectations: Explains that chatting is the gateway's local agent API, not the Config API
Mentions the gateway's MCP server (doxxGateway mcp) and tools such as chat_send and wait_for_message
Does not invent a Config API endpoint for sending chat
